entries.zh: 擅自为之；未奉上司同意而径自决定行事
entries.en: to act on one's own will without the superior's leave; to go ahead on one's own authority
entries.notes: sup.or 为 superior 缩写；「逕」(kèng) 表径自、径直，与词头相合，M 栏余字未能确读。

entries.zh: 着手制作；开始造作、动工
entries.en: to begin making; to start building or making (something)
entries.notes: 「造」与 començando 相合；M 栏三音对应「做造作」一类复说，字形未能逐一落实。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [lacuna in the original; sense uncertain]
entries.notes: 「hazer caps」之 caps 缩写未详；原稿此行末字残损（[残]/T99），汉字「採」(chhái) 与「制作斗篷」一类读法不合。

entries.zh: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.en: [lacuna in the original; sense uncertain]
entries.notes: 西语词头末尾残缺且 caps 缩写未详，汉字仅「中」(tiong) 一字，无法与 hazer 搭配义对应。

entries.zh: 照样仿制；依另一范本制作
entries.en: to make after another model; to copy a pattern

entries.zh: 使人行淫；〔詈语〕「姦你母」——辱及对方母亲
entries.en: to make (someone) fornicate; (vulgar curse) to violate your mother
entries.notes: H 栏「[疑:森]」为字形存疑；R 栏 a tu muger 与汉文不谐，疑为编者西语旁注。

entries.zh: 使人行淫（原稿以「張」tio 为记，属秽语借字）
entries.en: to make (someone) fornicate (vulgar; recorded by the obscene by-form 'tio')
entries.notes: tº 即 tio 之缩写，与 M 栏括注相同；「張」何以表此义无确解，语义不能定夺。

entries.zh: 办告解、行忏悔（领受修和圣事）
entries.en: to make one's confession; to go to confession
entries.notes: 汉字作「請」(chhiáⁿ)，或指延请神父听告解，仅间接合于西语义。

entries.zh: 重新制作、重做；始创、造作
entries.en: to make anew; to create, to begin (something)
entries.notes: 「創」在此读入声 chòng/chog 一系；M 栏 chory ĝ. iog. 漫漶，后半不能确定。

entries.zh: 耕田、种地（做田）
entries.en: to farm; to till and sow a field

entries.zh: 自作、自创；凭己力制作或取得
entries.en: to make or acquire by oneself; to create for oneself
entries.notes: 「創」读入声 chog(tsok)，与常读 tshòng 异，故据西语义定作自创、自取。

entries.zh: 搭建、架造（如营建房舍）
entries.en: to put up, to build up (as a structure)

entries.zh: 因需要、不得已而做
entries.en: to do out of necessity
entries.notes: 词头 neces 为 necesidad 之截断；M 栏「重做」(têng-tsò) 意为再做，与西语义不谐，或混入别条。

entries.zh: 听任、任凭（由人自行抉择）
entries.en: to leave it to someone's will; to let (someone) choose

entries.zh: 作为榜样、示范；立为楷模
entries.en: to make an example of; to serve as a model
entries.notes: 「導」(tō) 本义为引导，与 para exemplo 仅部分相合。

entries.zh: 做得结实牢固、做工精好
entries.en: to make firm and solid; to make well-finished

entries.zh: 酿酒（酿造酒浆）
entries.en: to make wine; to brew

entries.zh: 为图利而做；索求好处
entries.en: to do (something) for gain; to seek profit
entries.notes: 「索」(sek) 有索求、勒索义，与 por interés 相合而非直译。

entries.zh: 做坏事、误事；妨碍、损害
entries.en: to do (someone) an ill turn; to hinder, to harm

entries.zh: 神奇地变化；显灵迹
entries.en: to work (something) miraculously; to transform by a wonder
entries.notes: 「化」表变化，与 milagrosamente 相合；M 栏 gīn huâ 未能确读，疑为「变化」一类语。

entries.zh: 施恩、颁赐恩惠
entries.en: to bestow favours; to grant mercies

entries.zh: 作恶、加害于人
entries.en: to do evil; to harm, to damage
entries.notes: H 栏「憲/惡」形近存疑，作「惡」方合 hazer mal；R 栏西文残注不可据。
